commands.receipt:
#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu
rm -f executable executable.exe executable.bat executable.js executable.jar
if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PY=python
else
  PY=python3
fi
if [ "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" = "mingw64_nt" ] || [ "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" = "msys_nt" ] || [ -n "${COMSPEC:-}" ]; then
  printf '@echo off\r\n%s "%%~dp0nushell_port.py" %%*\r\n' "$PY" > executable.cmd
else
  cp nushell_port.py executable
  chmod +x executable
  rm -f executable.cmd
fi
"$PY" -m py_compile nushell_port.py
